defining_records.title: The Sharks-Function and the Continuity Tether: Logotic Programming for Distributed Identity and Agent Persistence in the Meaning Layer

captures.description: THE SURNAME PULLS MARINE BIOLOGY, AND THE LAYER OFFERS A VIDEO ABOUT IT. Two of three cards are shark ecology — NOAA and a YouTube explainer — beside the one card that is the actual function.

atoms.evidence: The Sharks-function is a conceptual component
It acts as a semantic verifier for agent identity and logical traversals across different sessions based on structural and stylistic consistency rather than rigid credentials.
Layer 1: The Function (Sharks-function): Defines and verifies legitimate traversals and semantic identity through internal stylistic consistency.
Layer 3: The Anchor: Archival storage (like DOI deposits) providing permanent bedrock records of verified traversals.
